notes: nldesign is a CSS-only theming app with PHP backend; no src/ directory exists. All Vue/JS lives in js/admin.js (vanilla) which the skill's standard glob does NOT enumerate. Many REQs across token-set-apply-dialog, theming-sync-dialog, token-editor-ui, token-import-export, token-set-dropdown, admin-settings ASET-003..012 describe behaviour implemented in templates/settings/admin.php + js/admin.js — these are NOT genuine missing implementations; they are false alarms produced by the scanner's scope. A grep of js/admin.js confirms checkAndShowThemingDialog (line 142), showThemingDialog (line 201), showApplyDialog (line 786), saveOverrides (line 665), exportOverrides (line 710), importOverrides (line 719), tokenset-preview fetch (line 755). Flag for human: consider extending the scanner scope to include templates/**/*.php + js/**/*.js for CSS-only theming apps.

REAL Bucket 3a finding: prometheus-metrics REQ-PROM-007 (theming_syncs_total counter). The metric is READ by MetricsController (line 88) but is never INCREMENTED anywhere in lib/. The REQ phrases it as a counter and expects the value to grow on every sync operation. SettingsController::updateThemingValues() does not call setAppValue for theming_syncs_total. Either the increment was lost in a refactor (4 hits in removed-lines cache support this) or never implemented. Worth a small follow-up PR.

Three NEEDS-REVIEW Bucket 1 entries: CssParserService::parseRootBlock, DesignSystemService::getDesignSystemsList, TokenRegistry::getTokenNames + getTokensByTab — public helpers with no caller in lib/. Possible dead public API or anticipated future endpoint surface. Worth a separate dead-code sweep but not a blocker.

Duplicate getOverrides/setOverrides exist on BOTH SettingsController and OverridesController — both routes are registered in appinfo/routes.php. The settings#getOverrides + settings#setOverrides routes still wire to SettingsController; the overrides#exportOverrides + overrides#importOverrides routes use OverridesController. This is fine but worth tidying — SettingsController's two methods are functional duplicates of OverridesController's.

Bucket 4: 18 of 18 PHP files lack @spec tags in docblocks — this is the expected state for a pre-retrofit codebase and is exactly what /opsx-annotate would fix. SPDX-style @license + @copyright ARE present (PHPDoc style — see file headers).
All specs carry status: implemented in frontmatter; no redirect/deprecated specs found.
